name: google-workspace-mcp
description: Google Workspace as one stdio MCP server (workspace-mcp, pinned): Google Tasks by default, any other service opt-in. Credentials come from a credential command you name, then the environment, then a prompt, so a secret held elsewhere is never copied.

tools.title: Services
tools.description: Comma-separated workspace-mcp services to load. Default: tasks. Others: appscript, calendar, chat, contacts, docs, drive, forms, gmail, search, sheets, slides. Chat needs a Workspace account. Each added service widens the OAuth scopes and asks you to sign in again.

credential_command.title: Credential command (optional)
credential_command.description: A command PREFIX that runs its trailing arguments with GOOGLE_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID and GOOGLE_OAUTH_CLIENT_SECRET in the environment, e.g. `op run --env-file=/path/google.env --` or `envchain google`. Split on spaces, no quoting. Wins over the environment and the two fields below.

client_id.title: OAuth client ID (optional)
client_id.description: Used only when neither the credential command nor the environment supplies GOOGLE_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID. A Google Cloud OAuth client of type Desktop app.

client_secret.title: OAuth client secret (optional)
client_secret.description: Used only when neither the credential command nor the environment supplies GOOGLE_OAUTH_CLIENT_SECRET. Stored in the OS credential store, never in settings.json.

email.title: Google account email (optional)
email.description: Sets USER_GOOGLE_EMAIL, which makes the user_google_email tool argument optional and defaults it to this address. Leave empty and the model must pass the address on each call.
